### **Create Smarter, Faster & More Human**

### **healthcare Marketing with AI**

### **Join us June 17 for an exclusive meet-up in Indianapolis!**

Hear how healthcare marketing and communication leaders are experimenting, adapting and moving at the speed of change with AI.

This free event will show how AI is driving day-to-day efficiency, refining and personalizing HCP messaging and scaling campaigns with confidence. Learn the practical plays you can apply today, and how small experiments turn into big wins!

This event is for Life Science, biotech, and medtech professionals only, you can register opposite:

Special thanks to the event sponsor, **Real Chemistry**.

## Expert Speakers

### Lois-an Gregory

###### Strategy and Insight Lead, Health & Wellness, Google

Lois ("Loy") Gregory is a design thinker, motivator and CXO-whisperer. At Google, she leads health & wellness research, strategy & insights - anticipating and answering the big questions that support data-driven decision making and transform industries. Outside of the office, she’s passionate about community, wellness & medicine, culture and the arts. Based in NYC, you can often find her at the museum, art galleries or at dinner with friends.

### Jeremy Rogers

###### Vice President of Patient and Consumer Experience at Indiana University Health

Jeremy leads the customer experience function of Indiana’s largest and most comprehensive health system. With over 20 years of experience across multiple industries, he has successfully led and developed agile, product-focused teams that have revolutionized customer-facing experiences and enhanced digital capabilities. A native Hoosier, Jeremy holds a bachelor’s degree in economics from Indiana University.

### Georgia Twersky

###### Marketing Manager for Digital Solutions, Roche Diagnostics

Georgia Twersky is currently a Marketing Manager for Digital Solutions at Roche Diagnostics. Bringing to the table a background in business operations and sales enablement, Georgia is responsible for portfolio strategy for Roche's suite of digital products supporting the digitization of pathology labs. Outside of her role, she is an EverydayAI Champion helping build AI literacy for Roche employees. She holds an undergraduate degree in International Economics from the University of Notre Dame and a Masters in Business Administration from Purdue Global University.

‍

### Bert Vargas

###### Bert Vargas, MD, FAAN, Adjunct Clinical Professor of Neurology

### Alyson Hagert

###### President, Digital and Social Media, Real Chemistry

Over the past decade, Alyson Hagert has gone from helping interpret some of the FDA’s earliest social media guidance to leading the industry’s largest healthcare-only social and digital team as President of Social & Digital Activation at Real Chemistry. She oversees global work across Integrated Communications, Advertising, Medical Education, and influencer initiatives for both HCP and patient audiences.​

#### **AI, Trust & Patient Behaviour: Lois-An Gregory on the Future of Healthcare Search**

In this episode of the ***solli Sessions*** podcast, Lois-An Gregory, Principal Strategy & Insights Lead at Google, discusses how AI is transforming the way patients search for healthcare information, why health literacy and trust are becoming increasingly important, and how data-driven insights can help healthcare organisations create more meaningful patient experiences.

**What to expect from this episode**

* **Understanding Modern Patient Behaviour** – Why long-held assumptions about patients are changing and what today’s healthcare organisations need to understand.
* **The Rise of AI Search** – How conversational AI is transforming the way people discover and engage with healthcare information.
* **Health Literacy & Trust** – Why clearer communication and greater accessibility are essential to improving patient outcomes.
* **Finding Meaning in Data** – How asking better questions helps organisations uncover more valuable insights and make smarter decisions.
* **The Future of Healthcare Innovation** – From personalised medicine to AI-driven healthcare experiences, the trends shaping the industry’s next chapter.

Whether you’re a healthcare marketer, digital strategist, or healthcare leader, this episode offers thoughtful perspectives on how technology and human understanding can work together to create better experiences for patients and better outcomes for the industry.

Don’t miss this conversation with one of the industry’s leading voices on AI, patient insights, and the future of healthcare communications.
